episodes.synopsis: An ordinary village boy wakes up to find he's been reborn as Noah Ararat, the thirteenth prince of the empire.
episodes.title: Thirteenth Imperial Prince Noah Ararat

episodes.synopsis: While walking through the city, Noah enters a venue and is left speechless by the talent of a singer.
episodes.title: The Birth of the Songstress

episodes.synopsis: Noah gains another powerful subordinate, but suffers a blow when a rebellion breaks out in Almeria.
episodes.title: Those Gained, Those Lost

episodes.synopsis: Noah deals with the rebel forces leading an uprising in his domain.
episodes.title: The Almerian Rebellion

episodes.synopsis: Noah makes it his goal to show his thanks to the people who have given him their loyalty and cooperation.
episodes.title: People Are Treasures

episodes.synopsis: Now twelve years old, Noah is recognized for his exceptional knowledge of military affairs and imperial law.
episodes.title: Dark Clouds

episodes.synopsis: Noah catches a spy in the act and learns of a plot against the emperor's life.
episodes.title: The Highest Trust

episodes.synopsis: The emperor suggests a potential wife for Noah: the granddaughter of his uncle, Indra the Lightning Prince.
episodes.title: Lightning Prince and Wise Prince

episodes.synopsis: The emperor makes the decision to disinherit the crown prince... but not before seeking Noah's advice.
episodes.title: Disinheritance

episodes.synopsis: Noah catches Albert in the act of attempting a coup and gives him one last chance to repent.
episodes.title: Nobility
